headline: NaturalShrimp Inc disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern
label: Going concern
quote: Going Concern Due to its limited operations, limited cash and significant net liabilities as of June 30, 2026 the Company has concluded that there is substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern within one year after its financial statements were issued. The Company hopes to raise funds in the private markets to fund its business operations. However, no plans were finalized as of the time of this filing. headline: Dogness (International) Corp disclosed substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern
label: Going concern
quote: … relating to the recoverability of assets and classification of liabilities that might be necessary should the Company be unable to continue as a going concern. For the years ended June 30, 2026, 2025 and 2024, the Company incurred net losses of $27,629,171, $5,101,237 and $6,056,649, respectively. Net cash used in operating activities was $2,251,071 for the year ended June 30, 2026. These factors raise substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern.
